title: NOBLE JUMP 17 - Norwegian troop arrival in C17
description:
Friday 2nd June, a third military flight delivered military vehicles to Norwegian troops, participating in NATO exercise Noble Jump 2017 in Romania. This NATO C17 provides the last military vehicle rotation to the Norwegian contingent: 2 BV 206, 4 Mercedes Benz 240 terrain vehicles jeeps, two pilots cargo and 6 pax. 

Major Steinar HOLEN, J4 Branch in Norwegian North Brigade, oversees the unload of military material. “Among the passengers, the artillery battery commander is arrived with three platoons commanders and some signal specialists. Almost all the equipment has arrived in Romania by plane. Just some few munitions and weapons are lacking. They will arrive by plane next Tuesday with the main body, 33 Norwegian soldiers more”.

Journalists: Eloise ROSSI and Dennis TAPPE
